items.definition:
a combination of elements from various sources
The DJ created a mashup of two popular songs.

a member of a criminal gang
The movie was about a notorious mobster from the 1930s.

the number nine, especially in radio communication
The pilot confirmed the altitude as 'flight level niner zero'.

the state of being normal
After the storm, everyone longed for a return to normalcy.

an amount of money spent
The initial outlay for the project was significant.

a Hindu scholar or priest
The pandit led the ceremony with great reverence.

a person or group that maintains peace
UN peacekeepers were deployed to the conflict zone.

a Hawaiian staple food made from taro; a type of juggling prop
We tried poi for the first time during our trip to Hawaii.

a four-sided court or yard
Students often gather in the college quadrangle between classes.

the quality of being quick
Her quickness of thought allowed her to solve the problem rapidly.

a track for racing
The cars sped around the raceway at incredible speeds.

the act of entering again
The spacecraft's reentry into the atmosphere was carefully monitored.

an addition of new parts or equipment to something that was built or made in the past
The building underwent a major energy-efficient retrofit.

a powerful hitter in baseball
The team's new slugger hit a home run in his first game.

a type of grain or grass grown for food or fodder
Sorghum is a drought-resistant crop.

a device used to create a space or distance between two things
He used a small plastic spacer to ensure even gaps between the tiles.

a soft, wet, yielding sound or sensation
The mud made a satisfying squish as he walked through it.

a large area of flat grassland with no trees
Wild horses galloped across the vast steppe.

the quality of being determined not to change your mind or do what other people want
His stubbornness made it difficult to reach a compromise.

a strikingly beautiful or impressive person or thing
The new building is an absolute stunner.

an absorbent pad or piece of material used for cleaning wounds or taking samples
The nurse used a swab to clean the wound.

a person who fights with a sword
He was known as the finest swordsman in the kingdom.

a minor detail or point of law
The case was dismissed on a legal technicality.

a type of unglazed, brownish-red earthenware
The garden pot was made of terracotta.

a small or medium-sized songbird
A thrush sang sweetly from the tree branch.

a member of a tribe
The tribesman wore traditional clothing.

a tuxedo
He looked sharp in his new tux.

A leguminous plant widely grown for fodder.
Alfalfa is often used as feed for livestock.

(In baseball) an intentionally soft hit.
The batter laid down a perfect bunt to advance the runner.

The action or process of placing into categories.
The categorization of data is essential for effective analysis.

A member of a group of peoples inhabiting much of Europe and Asia Minor in pre-Roman times.
The ancient Celts had a rich oral tradition.

A person whose trade is making or repairing shoes; also, a fruit dessert with a thick crust.
The old cobbler repaired my worn-out boots.

Excessive pride in oneself; a fanciful notion or expression.
His conceit made him difficult to work with.

A machine or device that appears strange or unnecessarily complicated, and often badly made or unsafe.
He built a strange contraption in his garage.

the process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in further detail
Could you provide further elaboration on your proposal?

fiction written by a fan of, and featuring characters from, a particular TV series, movie, etc.
She spends hours reading fanfiction based on her favorite book series.

a long, narrow opening or line of breakage made by cracking or splitting, especially in rock or earth
A deep fissure appeared in the rock after the earthquake.

A person or thing that gets something.
He's a good getter of information.

A rope or strap for leading or tying an animal; a type of top held by a strap around the neck.
She put the halter on the horse before leading it to the stable.

A person who travels about selling goods, typically shouting to advertise them.
The hawker was selling fresh fruit from his cart.

A person who illegally seizes an aircraft, vehicle, or cargo in transit.
The police arrested the hijacker after a long standoff.

A ship designed to break through ice; an activity or game designed to relax people and facilitate conversation.
The facilitator started with an icebreaker game to help everyone get to know each other.

A narrow strip of land with sea on either side, connecting two larger areas of land.
The Isthmus of Panama connects North and South America.

A deceptive move in sports; a juke joint
The running back made a quick juke to avoid the tackle.

Mercy; clemency
The judge showed leniency to the first-time offender.

A habitual gesture or way of speaking; an exaggerated artistic style
He had a peculiar mannerism of clearing his throat before speaking.

A large ray with wing-like pectoral fins
We saw a huge manta ray swimming gracefully near the reef.

a symbol or piece of text that is put in a document or other file to show where something else will be put later
This text is just a placeholder until we get the final content.

a substance used to preserve foodstuffs, wood, or other materials
Many processed foods contain artificial preservatives.

a type of unleavened bread, deep-fried and typically served with savory dishes in Indian cuisine
We had aloo gobi with hot puri for dinner.

the state of being proper, correct, and socially acceptable
She always tried to maintain an air of respectability.

a person or thing that rushes; a player who carries the ball in American football
The running back is a powerful rusher for the team.

a giant redwood tree
The sequoia trees in California are incredibly tall.

a person or thing that solves a problem or mystery
She is known as an excellent problem solver.

a southern region or country
They traveled to the Southland for the winter.

a motion picture with synchronized sound
The Jazz Singer was one of the first talkies.

thing (informal)
Let me tell you somethin' about that thang.

a means of deciding a winner when there is a tie
The game went into a tiebreaker after both teams scored equally.

a short, sharp cry or bark
The small dog gave a sudden yip of excitement.

a swollen area within body tissue, containing pus
The dentist drained the abscess in his gum.

a type of chalcedony, typically banded
The necklace was made with polished agate stones.

a son of the Emperor of Austria
Archduke Franz Ferdinand's assassination sparked World War I.

a plant of the daisy family, typically having purple or white flowers
She planted purple asters in her garden.

a female spirit in Irish folklore whose wailing warns of a death in a house
According to legend, the banshee's cry foretells doom.
